speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: The Merdeka Generation Package (MGP) is a way for us to show our appreciation for their contributions and to show care for them in their silver years.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: This Package not only provides MG with greater peace of mind over their healthcare costs but also supports them in staying active and healthy.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: They will soon start to enjoy benefits that will help them stay active and healthy.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: All of these items in the MGP come on top of substantial healthcare subsidies that the Government already provides to all Singaporeans.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: To reach out to our MG seniors, since April this year, the Silver Generation Office (SGO), part of the Agency for Integrated Care (AIC), has started the process of engaging our seniors through home visits and community events.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: As many of our MG seniors are still working, SGO will supplement their current residential-based outreach approach with engagements in workplaces and community spaces.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: The Government is also putting out information on the MGP to our seniors and their families through a wide range of platforms, such as television interstitials, radio segments, online channels like YouTube and Facebook, and roadshows.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: The Bill provides for the establishment and administration of the MG Fund.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: The Government will continue to monitor healthcare costs and utilisation, as well as life expectancy, to ensure that we are able to fund these key healthcare benefits.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: As the amendment Bill rides on the Pioneer Generation (PG) Fund Act to establish the MG Fund, we have proposed that the Act be renamed the "Pioneer Generation and Merdeka Generation Funds Act".

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Amendments to Part 2 of the Act establishes the MG Fund as a separate Fund from the PG Fund and sets out the purposes for which moneys in the MG Fund may be used.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: The general responsibility for the management and administration of both Funds lies with the Minister for Finance and the amendments provide for the presentation of separate annual financial statements and Auditor’s report for each Fund to Parliament.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Amendments to Part 3 of the Act define the eligibility criteria for an individual to be considered an MG Senior and outline the benefits which MG Seniors receive as part of the MGP.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Amendments to Part 3 also provide for the powers of the Appeals Panel and the process for appealing to be an MG Senior.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: The current Act already provides that the Appeals Panel will only consider appeals from Singapore Citizens who meet the age criteria.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: So, they have to meet the age criteria and the Appeals Panel will consider other considerations, namely, the citizenship criterion.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: If a person is born before 31 December 1949 and did not receive the PG Package previously, the Appeals Panel may assess and determine that they are eligible for the MG Package.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: Amendments to Parts 4 and 5 of the Act relate mainly to the power to make regulations for carrying out the purposes and provisions of the Act as amended by the amendment Bill and the proper conduct of officers and entities exercising functions in relation to the MG Fund.

speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Mr Lawrence Wong)
text: This is how we can honour our MG for their contributions and give them and their families greater peace of mind with their healthcare costs.
